data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of James total 12, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.

tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Yaʿaqov (Jacob), from the root ʿ-q-b, 'heel' — 'one who grasps the heel', hence 'supplanter'. Its root is Hebrew ʿ-q-b. James the Apostle; the Epistle of James. James is a Hebrew name meaning “Supplanter; one who follows”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
